messages.text: Here is my business: https://mainstreet-demo-sites.vercel.app/diner/. What should I try first?

Hi Carol! I'd try a website chat helper first. It answers questions about hours, large parties and catering while you're busy cooking. I saved a few other ideas on your page too: review replies and specials posts.

My pick is Chatling. It has a free plan, and our team has verified it. It takes about 30 minutes, and I can set it up for you.

One catch: after it's trained on your pages, someone has to paste a small code snippet into your website. Whoever manages your site can do that.

Want me to set it up for you? I'll ask your approval first. I won't create anything until you say yes.
Compare tools for Answer website questions day and night

Here are your three choices for website chat:

- Chatling: free plan, paid from $25 a month. About 30 minutes, and I can set it up for you. Verified by our team.
- Tidio (Lyro AI Agent): free plan with 50 chats, paid from about $29 a month. About 30 minutes, and you'd set it up yourself. Also verified.
- ChatBot: no free plan, from $19 a month after a 14-day trial. About 20 minutes, and you'd set it up yourself. Also verified.

I'd pick Chatling because it's free to start and I can do the sign-up. In our simulated owner test, the hard part for all three was adding the chat box to the website.

Want me to set up Chatling for you?
Compare tools for Reply to Google and Yelp reviews

Here are three choices for review replies:

- RightResponse AI: from $10 a month, with a 7-day free trial. It covers Google reviews only. Verified by our team, with the best trust score. About 30 minutes, and you'd set it up yourself.
- Reviewflowz: $45 a month. It covers Google and Yelp. Our team says use with caution. Easy setup, about 30 minutes.
- INFI: price on request. It covers Google. Our team says use with caution. About an hour.

I'd pick RightResponse AI because it's the most trusted and the cheapest. In our simulated owner test, setup was the hard part, so a local helper could assist.

I can't set up any of these for you. Want a sign-up link, or help from a local helper?
Compare tools for Post your specials and pie of the day

Here are three choices for posting your specials:

- Apaya: $55 a month, with a 3-day trial. It writes and schedules Facebook and Instagram posts from your website and photos. Verified by our team. Easy, about 20 minutes.
- Pluspoint: $87 a month, because it requires 3 locations. It does posts, review replies and chat. Verified. Medium setup, about 45 minutes.
- INFI: price on request. It writes Google posts and texts offers. Our team says use with caution. About an hour.

I'd pick Apaya because it's the easiest and the best fit for posts. In our simulated owner test, connecting Facebook and Instagram was the likely sticking point. It also asks for a card to start the trial.
